roleZh: 在电隔离的同时将芯片热量传向底板。
roleEn: Provides electrical isolation while conducting die heat toward the baseplate.
featuresZh: 两片铜/陶瓷/铜衬板。铜层图形、电压等级与热循环寿命需专门设计。
featuresEn: Two copper / ceramic / copper substrates. Copper patterning, voltage rating and thermal-cycle life require dedicated design.
materialZh: Si₃N₄ 陶瓷与铜；以活性金属钎焊结合。
materialEn: Si₃N₄ ceramic and copper joined by active-metal brazing.
